card.name: Chinese imperial dynasties and emperors
card.fires_on: Words inside discussions of Chinese imperial history, such as the 'dyn' of dynasties, 'dynasty', 'the' before Emperor, and digits in Qing dynasty dates. Also some words in similar history passages about kings and empires.

modes.label: Dynasty words
modes.description: The word 'dynasty' or its first piece, after Qing, Ming or emperor.
